exposure: early gestational diabetes (GDM) screening (HbA1c >= 5.7% or FPG >= 92 mg/dL at <=24 weeks gestation, or abnormal 2-h GTT between 24-28 weeks)
cohort: The study included women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with GDM between July 2010 and June 2012.
finding: Implementing early GDM screening nearly doubled GDM incidence and increased pharmacotherapy needs, with maternal BMI being the strongest predictor of medication requirements, but showed no significant difference in neonatal outcomes compared to standard screening.
birth_weight: mixed, reported as means 3240 g and 3179 g in two cohorts
